headline: Assessing conformational ensembles and dynamics of flexible and disordered proteins
label: Conformational Ensemble Analysis Tools
summary: Recent preprints and a published tool test how well ensemble, network, and dimensionality methods capture protein conformational variability.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the quantitative description of conformational variability using graph, network, dimensionality, and benchmarking approaches rather than single static structures. A systematic benchmark of five ensemble-generation strategies for flexible domain-linker-domain proteins is tested against experimental SAXS data, asking how accurate and reliable predicted ensembles are. Residue interaction networks are compared across multiple conformations of wild-type and G188R G6PC1, and MDIntrinsicDimension estimates the intrinsic dimension of collective motions from MD trajectories. Pocket-similarity graphs of 400 amyloid-beta, tau and synuclein cryo-EM fibril structures identify shared and selective ligand pockets, while proteome-scale coarse-grained simulations of 14,283 human proteins show that full-length architecture reshapes IDR conformations. RevelioPlots adds a quality-assessment layer for AI-predicted models. What is new is the convergence of experimental benchmarking with graph-based and coarse-grained descriptors applied at proteome and fibril-polymorph scale.
